implementation: round2-agent: Round 2 Receiving Manager deterministic rules (decision_engine.py) + Round 2 VisionService. Default 'recorded' mode runs the operator-recorded receipt through the Round 2 rules with no model call; 'vision' mode (RECEIVING_VISION=on + OPENAI_API_KEY + image captures in data/input) makes one batched multimodal call per unit. See PROVENANCE.md.
